locator_roots.repo: Files in repository at named revision.
locator_roots.coordination: Selected private ns2604-coop coordination records; host paths omitted.
locator_roots.scratch: Original private ns2604-coop execution/review archive; host paths omitted.

persistent_4c_source.fallback: Original scratch:fixwave/ records; no persistent census invented.

sanitization: Only slot IDs, stage/process results/times, scoped reviewer labels and original hash metadata are retained.
Absolute host paths and native session/thread IDs are omitted.
Event streams are hashed without parsing/copying conversations.
Review reasons, raw stdout/stderr, credentials and active client configuration are not copied.
Integration/fixture results, unchanged upstream tests, verdicts and historical labels remain distinct.
hash_boundary: SHA-256 proves original byte identity, not execution success, adequate acceptance, independent review or public availability.
